features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
items: Fast checkout
Big buttons, camera or scanner, cash sales even offline.
Customer tabs
Per-customer limits, repayments, WhatsApp receipts.
Stock & expiry
Low-stock and expiry alerts, a log of every movement.
Smart restock
7-day demand forecast per product, tested against simple baselines.
Suppliers
Orders, deliveries that update stock, recalculated average cost.
WhatsApp assistant
"Sold 3 bread" or "sugar 12": record it without opening the app.
Honest reports
Sales net of returns, margins at real cost, in your time zone.
Your data
Full export in one click, delete your account anytime.

pilot.title: Pilot program
pilot.sub: Souk.AI is young. We're looking for neighborhood shops — grocers, convenience stores, bakeries, small restaurants — to use it every day and tell us what's missing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Do I need a computer?
No. An Android phone or an iPhone is enough; tablets and PCs work too.
What if the internet goes down?
Cash sales are kept on the phone and sent as soon as you're back online, without duplicates.
Which languages?
French, Arabic and English in the app; the WhatsApp assistant also understands Moroccan Darija.
Is my data mine?
Yes. You can export everything or delete your account from Settings.
